mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, it is 54 degrees under overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park. The waxing crescent moon is out, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona reminds residents that four polling locations are available for the upcoming election. Please visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm your ward and designated location, as some assignments have changed.

We have a busy schedule starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, evening activities at ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, enjoy live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from the past week, officers responded to a single-vehicle motorcycle crash on October 5 on USH 18/151, where a 19-year-old was transported to a local hospital.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head on over once they open to get your scoop.
